title: Magnetic field B1 magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B1 = 0.2 T using the radius of motion in the second quadrant and the Lorentz force.

title: Time in rectangular field
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time t = 3.9e-8 s for the quarter-circular motion in the B2 region.

title: Minimum area S
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum area S = 4.14e-3 m² for the rectangular magnetic field region.

title: Electric field magnitude E
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the electric field E = 1.2e6 N/C from its vector components.

title: Geometry for radii
description: Important: Correctly determines the radii r1 and r2 from geometric constraints and the Lorentz force.

title: Electric field components
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to find the horizontal (Ex) and vertical (Ey) components of the electric field.

title: Path symmetry analysis
description: Important: Recognizes the symmetry of the particle's full path and the velocity conditions at key points (Q, M, return to P).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (meters, seconds, Teslas, N/C) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in components
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to the electric field components (Ex, Ey) relative to the particle's velocity changes.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the 30° angle or the entry/exit conditions, leading to an incorrect radius r1 or rectangle dimensions.
